User strongly frustrated (explicit anger) by the graph-hygiene work feeling like an endless loop: problems discovered host-by-host over many turns, ~15 small commits, and repeated capture-gate false-positives interrupting recap/verification turns. Lesson: for a multi-host framework fix, front-load the full design (all detector cases) in one pass instead of iterating per host; and the capture-gate FP pattern (13+ today) materially worsened the churn.

Observed (medivance session, screenshot 2026-07-05): agent tried to launch a dev instance by repeatedly improvising nohup and failing, instead of map-first searching the governing record. The host already documents the proper path (named-dev-instance-workflow.md SSOT + package.json dev:instances/inspect/status/stop/logs via scripts/dev-instance-cli.ts). Pattern: on a HOST-COMMAND task (launch/run/deploy an instance), agents skip §2.1 search-first and improvise shell instead of reading the governing workflow record first. Generalizable lesson: host-command/ops tasks are host-dependent -> map-first + read the ops/workflow record before improvising.
